finding: Subscribers active on fewer than half as many days as the month before: 66% churn next quarter vs 13% for those holding steady (5.1x).
action: Trigger a contact in the week activity halves, not after recharges stop.

finding: No recharge for 3+ weeks: 51% churn next quarter vs 9% for those who recharged in the last week (5.9x).
action: Silence is the strongest signal but arrives late; treat 21+ days as last-chance win-back.

finding: Recharges more than halved vs the previous month: 24% churn next quarter vs 9% for steady rechargers (2.8x).
action: Today's win-back rule uses this; the model ranks within it far better.

finding: Subscribers in their first 6 months: 29% churn next quarter vs 12% for 5+ year customers (2.5x).
action: Invest in onboarding (first 90 days) rather than late rescue for new SIMs.

finding: Street activation-kiosk acquisitions: 19% churn next quarter vs 16% for all other channels (1.2x).
action: Review kiosk incentives: they buy SIMs, not customers.

finding: Sylhet, Barishal and Rangpur: 18% churn next quarter vs 15% for Dhaka (1.2x).
action: A network problem, not a marketing one: share this with the network team before buying offers.

finding: No pack bought in 90 days: 34% churn next quarter vs 10% for regular pack buyers (3+) (3.2x).
action: Pack habits anchor people; a first-pack nudge is a cheap retention lever.

finding: Two or more 30-day silences in the past year: 21% churn next quarter vs 11% for never dormant (1.9x).
action: Serial sleepers: likely secondary SIMs; don't spend premium offers on them.
